verdict.rationale: Inngest natively supports cron-based scheduled functions with timezone support (inngest-docs-17), plus long-running/recurring workflows via durable steps, waits, and event-driven triggers (inngest-docs-18, inngest-docs-2). Community evidence corroborates real-world use for scheduling/queue/trigger needs (inngest-comm-1). Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of scheduling reliability at scale or edge-case failure reports specific to cron jobs.
